name: chalk
description: Chalk — the open-weight AI that quotes the job before you leave the driveway.

scripts.dev: concurrently --raw -n AGENT,WEB -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w services/agent" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build:all: npm run build -w apps/web && npm run build -w services/agent
scripts.test:py: uv run --project services/tabpfn --with pytest python -m pytest -q services/tabpfn/tests
